geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: GeoJSON Point, Polygon or MultiPolygon. Coordinates are x, y in the stated CRS (easting or longitude first).

crs_id.title: Crs Id
crs_id.description: Complete CRS identifier as an authority code, e.g. EPSG:4326.

unknowns.title: Unknowns
unknowns.description: Field name -> why its value is unknown. Never guessed.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.description: True when this project already holds an asset with identical content.

stored_original_reused.title: Stored Original Reused
stored_original_reused.description: True when identical content was already stored and no second copy was written.

aoi.description: Send null to remove the AOI.

georeferenced.title: Georeferenced
georeferenced.description: True only with a valid CRS, a usable geotransform and coordinates that fit the CRS.

footprint_4326.title: Footprint 4326
footprint_4326.description: GeoJSON outline (longitude, latitude). Null unless the raster is validly georeferenced.
